# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** 16  <sub>[v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Yankee  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric possesses features of delicate and exquisite refinement, large and extremely dark blue eyes, and a mouth with crimson lips. Originally having a halo of chestnut curls, by age sixteen he sports short-cut brown hair. Though previously tiny for his years, he grew tall for his time of life by age thirteen.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 c27 P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)_

## Personality

Cedric is an exceptionally imaginative, intelligent, and meditative child who displays great manliness in games despite his bashfulness and sensitive nature. He is known to be a little gentleman, deeply affectionate toward those close to him, and possesses a strong sense of fairness. His imagination turns everyday sights into vivid fancies, though as he grows older, his interest shifts toward sports like football.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)_

## History

Cedric Stanhope moved from Boston to Brierley to reside with his grandmother, Mrs. Stanhope, near the shore road. He began attending school under Nell Harcourt, forming an immediate and lasting bond of affection and understanding with her as a kindred spirit. At school, he proved to be a brilliant student and maintained good relations with his peers, even resolving a flag dispute with St. Clair Trask through a mutual pact of respect. He often shared his whimsical imaginary world of rock people and fairy fancies with Nell and later with Miss Rosalind Penrose. When his father, Stephen Stanhope, unexpectedly arrived to visit, Cedric's letter about Miss Rosalind indirectly brought his father and Rosalind back together. Following their marriage, Cedric embraced Rosalind as 'Mother Rosalind', reserving the plain title of 'mother' for his late biological parent. Over the years, Cedric grew tall, matured, and developed a love for football while maintaining his deep connection with his former teacher.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c15 P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026), [v2 c29 P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 c29 P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v3 c23 P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)_
